problem.content:
Most existing trading tools are either overly complex or limited in analytical depth.

Traders are forced to switch between multiple platforms to gather technical, fundamental, and sentiment data — wasting time and reducing accuracy.
problem.title: Market Problem

roadmap.content:
✅ Finalize MVP & internal testing
🔄 Integrate live market data and TradingView charts
🤝 Pilot partnerships with exchanges & brokers
🚀 Expand coverage to gold and forex markets
💼 Secure funding for Phase II scaling
roadmap.title: Growth Roadmap (Next 6 Months)

solution.content:
Our platform, Nexo-Trade, is a modular AI-powered analytics system that integrates seamlessly into any JavaScript-based website.

It combines AI sentiment analysis, automated technical insights, and a signal aggregator for unified, actionable intelligence.

The system adapts to different markets — crypto, gold, stocks, and forex — and aligns its signals with the trader's preferred style (short-, mid-, or long-term).
